# p0_aws_function_caller_staged (Resource)

A staged AWS function caller, which lets P0 invoke one Lambda function. Staging gives you the IAM role to create in the function's account.

Create the role from the read-only `role` attributes, then create a `p0_aws_function_caller` resource with the same `id` to complete the installation.

Notifiers such as `p0_aws_lambda_notifier` call the function through it.

For the full install steps, see [AWS Lambda notifier](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/notifier-integrations/custom-notifiers/aws-lambda-notifier).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stage the function caller: computes the role P0 assumes to invoke the function,
# in the function's account.
resource "p0_aws_function_caller_staged" "example" {
  id = "arn:aws:lambda:us-west-2:123456789012:function:p0-notifier"
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "p0_function_caller" {
  name               = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.example.role.name
  assume_role_policy = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.example.role.trust_policy
}

# Allows the role to invoke the function, and nothing else.
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "p0_function_caller" {
  name   = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.example.role.inline_policy_name
  role   = aws_iam_role.p0_function_caller.name
  policy = p0_aws_function_caller_staged.example.role.inline_policy
}

# The p0_aws_function_caller example completes the install.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ARN of the Lambda function P0 invokes

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The function's AWS account ID, from its ARN
- `partition` (String) The function's AWS partition (`aws` or `aws-us-gov`), from its ARN
- `role` (Attributes) The AWS role that P0 assumes to invoke the function (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role))
- `service_account_id` (String) The audience ID of the service account to include in the role's trust policy
- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed

<a id="nestedatt--role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role`

Read-Only:

- `inline_policy` (String) The inline policy to attach to the role, which allows it to invoke the function
- `inline_policy_name` (String) The name of the inline policy
- `name` (String) The AWS role name
- `trust_policy` (String) The role's trust policy
